content.short: Build and deploy dApps on a single platform with Demeter – effortlessly scale to support millions of users.
content.description:
Demeter.run is a platform that provides Backend as a Service for dApps.

It covers the entire lifecycle of a web3 project, from its development phase to hosting in production environments for projects of all sizes.
